confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and the supplied comparable-city figures; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Beer and restaurant anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel rates vary by district and season and are less certain. Cocktail and wine_glass are weak direct estimates and follow the local price relationship to draught beer (cocktail about 4x beer, wine glass about 4.4x beer). The FX value comes from RBA-domain search results rather than a direct page read; the latest figure found is for 14 October 2026, and no 15 October reading was found.
comparable_city_reasoning: Anchored mainly to Siem Reap (same country, similar tourist-facing price base), with Nha Trang and Yogyakarta bounding the budget accommodation tiers. Food, drink and mid-range hotel anchors are set close to Siem Reap, with a modest upward adjustment for capital-city cafes and mid-range dining. Cocktail and wine have no comparable data and use the local beer relationship.
